journey.name: wear background disconnects spark
journey.description:
Leaving the watch app disconnects its Spark wallet after a grace period of 10 s, and coming back connects and syncs it again; a shorter trip away keeps it connected. Emulator and physical watch (on a watch, press the crown to leave the app and open it again from the launcher).
Precondition: Restored wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Restored wallet, on the Balance page with the loading ring stopped. Backend: hosted regtest. The wallet's log lines are in logcat under the tag `BitkitWear`.

actions.action: Run `adb shell "input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME; sleep 3; am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.wear.ui.MainActivity; sleep 2"`: one command, so the app is away for 3 s however slow the runner is
Run `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear | grep -c "Disconnected wallet"` and verify it prints 0: the app came back within the grace period
Run `adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_HOME` and wait 15 s
Run `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear | grep "Disconnected wallet because the app left the screen"` and verify it prints one line
Run `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear | grep "Synced wallet in"` every 5 s until it prints a line, for up to 1 minute: the wallet connected and synced again
